high_level_description: This image depicts a spiral staircase attached to the exterior of a brick building. The staircase is made of concrete steps with white metal railings that curve around the central cylindrical column. The column appears to be dark gray or black, providing a stark contrast to the lighter tones of the steps and railings. The building has multiple levels, each featuring a balcony with white railings. The balconies are spaced evenly along the height of the structure, suggesting it might be an apartment building.
